company.shortDescription: Zumo Labs uses game engines to produce synthetic training data for computer vision models.
company.description:
Zumo Labs uses game engines to produce synthetic training data for computer vision models. Zumo Labs also uses new ML-techniques like domain randomization to improve model performance.

The company delivers unbiased, diverse, perfectly-labeled data, free from privacy concerns.
